product_one_liner.value: Together AI provides a GPU cloud platform for AI engineers and researchers to run inference, fine-tune models, and train custom AI models at scale.
product_one_liner.notes: Together AI describes its audience as AI engineers and researchers and its capabilities as inference, fine-tuning, and large-scale training: https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/togetherai/jobs/4385540007 and https://trust.together.ai/compliance.

pricing_page.notes: The public pricing page describes pricing for serverless inference, dedicated endpoints, fine-tuning, and GPU clusters: https://www.together.ai/pricing.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Together AI explicitly calls Salesforce and Zoom customers, not merely partners or investors: https://trust.together.ai/compliance. | named_customers.0: Salesforce is explicitly identified as a customer: https://trust.together.ai/compliance. | named_customers.1: Zoom is explicitly identified as a customer: https://trust.together.ai/compliance.

employee_band.notes: The company profile reports 436 employees, which falls within 201-500. This is a third-party headcount rather than a direct company statement: https://tracxn.com/a/d/company/60a93e9184a11e4839b06955/together%20ai#a:about.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: Together AI's company profile explicitly identifies San Francisco as headquarters: https://linkedin.com/company/togethercomputer. | hq_country: The company profile identifies San Francisco as headquarters and gives its primary address in the US: https://linkedin.com/company/togethercomputer.

founded_year.notes: Together AI's company profile explicitly states Founded 2022: https://linkedin.com/company/togethercomputer.

eng_blog.notes: The research blog contains at least two named-author implementation articles: Together Compiler explains the team's cost-model and inference-engine design, while ThunderKittens describes the kernels team's GPU-kernel implementation. Engineering authorship is supported by first-person implementation work and team attribution, although individual job titles are not supplied. Sources: https://www.together.ai/research-blog; https://www.together.ai/blog/together-compiler-continual-compilation-for-ai-inference; https://www.together.ai/blog/to-infinity-and-beyond-thunderkittens-now-on-nvidia-vera-rubin-nvl72.

public_docs.notes: The public quickstart provides product instructions and links to several additional documentation articles covering model selection, dedicated inference, fine-tuning, and GPU clusters: https://docs.together.ai/docs/quickstart.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live Machine Learning Engineer - Inference posting includes an application option and has a qualifying machine-learning title: https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/togetherai/jobs/4385540007.

model_provider.value: Llama and Qwen, served through Together AI's inference engine.
model_provider.notes: The enterprise page explicitly names Llama and Qwen as models customers can run on the Together Inference Engine: https://www.together.ai/enterprise.

launched_6mo.notes: Together AI announced the launch of Together Compiler on November 4, 2026. This is a new compiler product rather than a bug fix or UI tweak, and falls within the requested six-month window: https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20261104879153/en/Together-AI-Launches-Together-Compiler-for-Continual-Optimization-of-Open-Source-AI-Models.
